resources.string: A quick tour — each step below matches a place in the app.

Open Menu → Presets and tap Add Karaoke Folder. One folder can hold songs (MIDI, KAR, MP3 or WAV), background photos, background videos, and a legacy IDX + BLOB pair — KANTA files each into its place.
Search the Stage by title, artist, or song code. Choose Reserve to add a song to Up Next, or Play to start it right away.
Open Menu → Stage & Visual and pick a background photo or video for the Stage.
Open the Stage Controls panel: the eight pads trigger your next songs for the group, so nobody searches for a title mid-song.
Open Menu → Intermission for between-song music, the Party Pads, your lyric settings and the Interlude message and image. Every editor shows a live preview of the Stage.
